lines.text: Paul says he received the gospel he preached by revelation from Jesus Christ, not from any man.
In Judaism Paul severely persecuted the church of God and was extremely zealous for the traditions of his fathers.
God revealed His Son in Paul to preach among the Gentiles, and Paul went into Egypt and later returned to Damascus.
After three years Paul went up to Jerusalem to confer with Barnabas, and he stayed fifteen days.
Paul went to Syria and Cilicia, and the churches of Judea, who only heard about him, glorified God because of him.
